verdict.rationale: Decagon says its chat, email, voice and proactive calls stay on-brand, and that voice agents are multilingual and customized to your brand. Experiments explicitly cover refining tone, and Simulations tests check that responses reflect your brand. Agent behavior is defined in natural-language AOPs, which implies tone is controllable. missing for 10: a documented dedicated tone/brand-voice configuration control, explicit evidence of voice consistency across languages beyond the voice channel and across topics, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing).
